comment: nodes: https://host entries (light-client nodes the site may use; the browser takes https only). tips: node -> where it serves its tip stream when that is not <node>/lc/tip (sm64coin-lc serve --tls-cert on its own HTTPS port); 0.5.6+ also read {"url", "tip"} objects in nodes, but older releases need nodes to be strings. url is for clients older than the nodes list. The apps also learn more nodes from Monero's get_public_nodes.
